event: Nala lays her torn forearm on the she-wolf's flank and pushes the sourness out into the carcass.

memory.fact: Undertow draws rot from Nala's own flesh as easily as from another's.
Undertow draws rot from Nala's own flesh as easily as from another's.
Rot pushed out of her into a carcass soaks into it and greys the dead flesh; it does not come back.
Rot pushed out of her into a carcass soaks into it and greys the dead flesh; it does not come back.

event: She pulls for clean life in the wolf; there is only cold brine, and a thread of it stings the wound.

memory.fact: A dead greymaw holds no clean life to take, only cold brine that stings a wound it is pulled into.
A dead greymaw holds no clean life to take, only cold brine that stings a wound it is pulled into.

event: The bite is clean now, but still open, ragged and bleeding a little.

memory.fact: Rid of its sourness, the crescent bite on Nala's left forearm is clean but still open and bleeding.
Rid of its sourness, the crescent bite on Nala's left forearm is clean but still open and bleeding.

event: Garth comes with the lantern: "That's the white-eye herself. The one that leads them."

memory.fact: Garth knows the dead she-wolf as the white-eye herself, the one that leads the pack.
Garth knows the dead she-wolf as the white-eye herself, the one that leads the pack.

event: By his fire she pushes her flow into the bite; brine rides in with it and stings like sea salt.

changes.note: She pushes her own Water into the bite

memory.fact: Pushed unsteadily, her well's brine rides in with her Water: it stings, and half-closes the wound.
Pushed unsteadily, her well's brine rides in with her Water: it stings, and half-closes the wound.

event: The torn edges knit from the ends inward, then the sting swamps it and the closing stops halfway.

changes.note: Her own Water half-closes the bite

memory.fact: Her own Water pushed into a wound knits its torn edges together from the ends inward.
Her own Water pushed into a wound knits its torn edges together from the ends inward.
Nala's crescent bite is sealed pink at its ends, its middle still open, raw and weeping.
Nala's crescent bite is sealed pink at its ends, its middle still open, raw and weeping.
Half-healed, Nala's bite no longer throbs deep; it aches only like a scraped knee.
Half-healed, Nala's bite no longer throbs deep; it aches only like a scraped knee.

event: "It closed! Half of it did. Can you do the rest?" Wren asks.

memory.fact: Wren saw Nala's bite half close, and asked whether she can heal the rest.
Wren saw Nala's bite half close, and asked whether she can heal the rest.

event: Garth fills a basin from the kettle: he'll wash out the wolf spit and salt before she tries more.

memory.fact: Garth would wash wolf spit and salt from Nala's half-healed bite before she tries more.
Garth would wash wolf spit and salt from Nala's half-healed bite before she tries more.

event: Turning Undertow on her own well, she pulls the salt from the foreign brine, grain by grain.

memory.fact: Turned on her own well, Undertow draws the salt out of foreign brine, leaving it clear Water.
Turned on her own well, Undertow draws the salt out of foreign brine, leaving it clear Water.

event: Her well settles cold and clear; a crust of grey salt fills her right palm.

changes.note: Her well settles full and clear once the brine's salt is drawn

memory.fact: Cleaning four greymaws' brine takes Nala some minutes and leaves a crust of grey salt on her palm.
Cleaning four greymaws' brine takes Nala some minutes and leaves a crust of grey salt on her palm.

event: She tries to push into the open middle, but her worn mind won't hold it; the flow slips twice.

memory.fact: When the day's fine work has worn her mind thin, a push slips and her Water will not gather.
When the day's fine work has worn her mind thin, a push slips and her Water will not gather.

event: "You're done in. Let me bind it, and then you eat. Wren, fetch the clean linen."

memory.fact: Garth means to bind Nala's bite and then have her eat; he sent Wren for clean linen.
Garth means to bind Nala's bite and then have her eat; he sent Wren for clean linen.

event: Garth binds the bite snug from wrist to elbow.

memory.fact: Garth bound Nala's bitten left forearm in Wren's clean linen, snug from wrist to elbow.
Garth bound Nala's bitten left forearm in Wren's clean linen, snug from wrist to elbow.

event: The Reeve pays two silver a head for greymaws; the chest bones only Carrowmouth folk buy.

memory.fact: The Reeve pays two silver a head for any greymaw brought in dead.
The Reeve pays two silver a head for any greymaw brought in dead.
Garth has only heard of Aberrant chest bones; Carrowmouth folk buy them, not valley folk.
Garth has only heard of Aberrant chest bones; Carrowmouth folk buy them, not valley folk.

event: Garth takes his stout skinning knife from its peg and saws into the nearest greymaw's chest.

memory.fact: Garth keeps a stout skinning knife on a peg at Marsh Croft.
Garth keeps a stout skinning knife on a peg at Marsh Croft.

event: Behind the breastbone: a fist-sized knot of polished grey bone, layered like a shell, dry and empty.

memory.fact: A greymaw's chamber is a fist-sized knot of polished grey bone, layered like a shell.
A greymaw's chamber is a fist-sized knot of polished grey bone, layered like a shell.
The three greymaws Nala drained keep their bone chambers whole but empty of Water.
The three greymaws Nala drained keep their bone chambers whole but empty of Water.

event: "Tough as ram's horn. Half an hour a beast with this knife, and there's four."

memory.fact: Cutting a chamber from behind the breastbone takes half an hour's hard work with a stout knife.
Cutting a chamber from behind the breastbone takes half an hour's hard work with a stout knife.
The dead she-wolf lies up the fell from Marsh Croft, dark against the heather.
The dead she-wolf lies up the fell from Marsh Croft, dark against the heather.

event: Nala leaves it for morning; Garth bars the door and dishes up supper.
She eats and sleeps hard by the fire; the night stays quiet, without a howl.

memory.fact: Leaderless, the pack does not come down to Marsh Croft at dawn on day two.
Leaderless, the pack does not come down to Marsh Croft at dawn on day two.

event: First light: rested, thirsty, the bite closed in the night to a crescent of pink new skin.

changes.note: The bite closes in the night

memory.fact: By dawn on day two Nala's crescent bite has closed in the night to pink new skin.
By dawn on day two Nala's crescent bite has closed in the night to pink new skin.

event: The greymaws lie stiff and untouched in the lane; even the crows keep away.

memory.fact: Nothing living will eat greymaw flesh; the carcasses lie untouched through the night.
Nothing living will eat greymaw flesh; the carcasses lie untouched through the night.

event: The empty chamber slips from her pull like a wet stone; she grips it by the flesh's Water instead.

memory.fact: An empty chamber gives the pull little to hold; she must grip it by the flesh's Water around it.
An empty chamber gives the pull little to hold; she must grip it by the flesh's Water around it.
Gripping a chamber by the flesh's Water pours the carcass's cold brine up her arm into her well.
Gripping a chamber by the flesh's Water pours the carcass's cold brine up her arm into her well.

event: Pull the chamber, push the flesh: long minutes, then a wet crack, and rank brine spatters her face.

changes.note: Tearing the chambers free spends her Water as cold brine pours in

memory.fact: Pulling a chamber while pushing the flesh round it tears it free in a few minutes, with a wet crack.
Pulling a chamber while pushing the flesh round it tears it free in a few minutes, with a wet crack.

event: The next two go quicker; three whole chambers lie grey in the grass beside her.

changes.note: Tearing three chambers free, a steady quarter hour's hard working

make.title: Greymaw Chamber
make.description: A fist-sized knot of polished grey bone, layered like a shell and empty of Water.

changes.note: Three whole chambers pulled from the lane greymaws

memory.fact: At dawn on day two Nala pulled three whole chambers from the lane greymaws with Undertow.
At dawn on day two Nala pulled three whole chambers from the lane greymaws with Undertow.

event: Up the fell, the she-wolf's chamber is twice as big, and cracked where the spear went in.

memory.fact: Nothing on the fells but the white-eye grows a chamber the size of hers.
Nothing on the fells but the white-eye grows a chamber the size of hers.

event: For a quarter hour she eases it a hair at a time, push and pull gentle as one; it comes free whole.

changes.note: A quarter hour easing the white-eye's cracked chamber: a hard working

make.title: White-Eye's Chamber
make.description: A knot of polished grey bone the size of two fists, layered like a shell and cracked through.

changes.note: The white-eye's chamber eased out whole

memory.fact: The she-wolf's cracked chamber splits in two if torn out roughly; eased out, it holds together.
The she-wolf's cracked chamber splits in two if torn out roughly; eased out, it holds together.
Nala eased the she-wolf's chamber out whole; twice a common one's size, cracked by the spear.
Nala eased the she-wolf's chamber out whole; twice a common one's size, cracked by the spear.

event: As it comes free, the floor of her well gives, like a step down into colder water.

memory.fact: As the way to First Depth opens, the floor of Nala's well gives, like a step down into colder water.
As the way to First Depth opens, the floor of Nala's well gives, like a step down into colder water.

event: Below it opens a vast, cold, patient dark, and it frightens her a little.

memory.fact: Below that step a vast, cold, patient dark presses up, and it frightens her a little.
Below that step a vast, cold, patient dark presses up, and it frightens her a little.

event: "Four! The Reeve'll not believe it. Come down, the porridge is on."
Over porridge she drinks two cups of water straight off; Wren can't stop looking at the chambers.
Garth stays to see to the ewes; Wren waves her off from the door, Burr at her knee.

changes.note: Nala leaves Garth's boar spear at Marsh Croft
The boar spear is out of her hand
Garth's boar spear stays at Marsh Croft

memory.fact: On the morning of day two Garth stays at Marsh Croft to see to his ewes.
On the morning of day two Garth stays at Marsh Croft to see to his ewes.
On the morning of day two Wren is up, and waves Nala off from Marsh Croft's door with Burr.
On the morning of day two Wren is up, and waves Nala off from Marsh Croft's door with Burr.

event: Nala sets off down the river lane, the four chambers bundled in her arms, the cracked one on top.

changes.note: The Sea refills her well on the walk down

memory.fact: On the morning of day two Nala carries the four greymaw chambers down the river lane to the Reeve.
On the morning of day two Nala carries the four greymaw chambers down the river lane to the Reeve.

event: A quarter hour down, Anselm hurries up the lane, muddy to the knees, grey under the eyes.

memory.fact: Coming up the river lane on day two, Anselm meets Nala on her way to the Ford.
Coming up the river lane on day two, Anselm meets Nala on her way to the Ford.
On day two Anselm is muddy to the knees and grey under the eyes from a sleepless night.
On day two Anselm is muddy to the knees and grey under the eyes from a sleepless night.

event: He felt a great drawing at Marsh Croft at dusk, came running, and lost his nerve at the fell's foot.

memory.fact: Anselm felt the drawing at Marsh Croft at dusk on day one, and set off up the valley at a run.
Anselm felt the drawing at Marsh Croft at dusk on day one, and set off up the valley at a run.
Nearing the dark fell at nightfall, Anselm lost heart for the pack and turned back to the shrine.
Nearing the dark fell at nightfall, Anselm lost heart for the pack and turned back to the shrine.
Anselm told Nala he was sorry he lost his nerve at the foot of the fell in the dark.
Anselm told Nala he was sorry he lost his nerve at the foot of the fell in the dark.

event: Nala is fine: she took out the alpha and thinned the pack. "You killed the white-eye."

memory.fact: Anselm knows Nala killed the white-eye; he knew its cracked chamber on sight, twice the others' size
Anselm knows Nala killed the white-eye; he knew its cracked chamber on sight, twice the others' size

event: No one in the valley buys chambers; Carrowmouth thaumists do, and his carrier comes on market day.

memory.fact: Anselm knows Carrowmouth thaumists buy Aberrant chambers; none in the valley would.
Anselm knows Carrowmouth thaumists buy Aberrant chambers; none in the valley would.
The carrier who takes Anselm's letters comes on market day, in two days, and could carry chambers.
The carrier who takes Anselm's letters comes on market day, in two days, and could carry chambers.

event: A whole chamber can hold a Talent's own Water, he says; the cracked one would only seep.

memory.fact: Anselm knows of no training use for an empty chamber but as a vessel for Water.
Anselm knows of no training use for an empty chamber but as a vessel for Water.
A whole Aberrant chamber can be filled with a Talent's own Water, and holds it for years.
A whole Aberrant chamber can be filled with a Talent's own Water, and holds it for years.
The white-eye's cracked chamber would leak away any Water put into it.
The white-eye's cracked chamber would leak away any Water put into it.

event: He'll walk her to the Reeve, then on to the shrine, as they said.

memory.fact: On day two Anselm offered to walk Nala to the Reeve, and then on to the shrine.
On day two Anselm offered to walk Nala to the Reeve, and then on to the shrine.

event: In Wendle Ford folk stop in their doors to stare at the grey knots of bone in her arms.
At the slate-roofed house Tam Oakes gapes, and calls back: "Reeve Dray, you'll want to see this!"

memory.fact: Dray is Reeve of Wendlemere; Tam Oakes, the Ford's village reeve, keeps his house by the green.
Dray is Reeve of Wendlemere; Tam Oakes, the Ford's village reeve, keeps his house by the green.

event: A grey, square man in a leather jerkin comes chewing his breakfast; Anselm names her the healer.

memory.fact: Reeve Dray is a grey, square man in a leather jerkin, whose watch lost a man to the white-eye.
Reeve Dray is a grey, square man in a leather jerkin, whose watch lost a man to the white-eye.
Anselm named Nala to Reeve Dray as the one who drew the rot from Tansy Horne and from Col.
Anselm named Nala to Reeve Dray as the one who drew the rot from Tansy Horne and from Col.

event: "Is that the white-eye's? My watch lost a man to that beast. Where are the carcasses, who saw?"

memory.fact: Dray knew the white-eye's chamber on sight, and asked Nala where the carcasses are and who saw.
Dray knew the white-eye's chamber on sight, and asked Nala where the carcasses are and who saw.

event: Up by Garth's place, for his cart; she got the alpha, but a few got away.

memory.fact: Nala told Dray the carcasses lie at Marsh Croft for his cart, and a few greymaws got away.
Nala told Dray the carcasses lie at Marsh Croft for his cart, and a few greymaws got away.

event: Col limps in on a stick: "If she says she did it, Reeve, she did it."

memory.fact: Col Ashby, up and walking with a stick, is at the Reeve's when Nala comes, and vouches for her.
Col Ashby, up and walking with a stick, is at the Reeve's when Nala comes, and vouches for her.

event: Dray bellows for the Cray brothers and the watch cart: four carcasses and Garth's word will do.

memory.fact: Dray takes the carcasses and Garth's word as proof enough; he needs no witness to the kill.
Dray takes the carcasses and Garth's word as proof enough; he needs no witness to the kill.
Dray sends Dunn and Aldo Cray with the watch cart to Marsh Croft; they are back by noon.
Dray sends Dunn and Aldo Cray with the watch cart to Marsh Croft; they are back by noon.
For a greymaw bounty the Reeve sends a cart to fetch the carcasses, and pays once he has seen them.
For a greymaw bounty the Reeve sends a cart to fetch the carcasses, and pays once he has seen them.

event: Two silver a head once the cart's back, and the watch's sworn silver bar for the white-eye.

memory.fact: The watch swore a silver bar from its chest to whoever killed the white-eye; Dray will honour it.
The watch swore a silver bar from its chest to whoever killed the white-eye; Dray will honour it.

event: Lambing is three weeks off; he wants the rest dead before it. Would she lead the hunt, for pay?

memory.fact: Lambing in Wendlemere begins in about three weeks.
Lambing in Wendlemere begins in about three weeks.
Dray wants the five greymaws left hunted down before lambing, and would pay Nala to lead the hunt.
Dray wants the five greymaws left hunted down before lambing, and would pay Nala to lead the hunt.

event: She'll hunt alone, for the best spear he can get her, and put up to two silver bars toward it.

memory.fact: Nala told Dray she will hunt the greymaws alone, and put up to two silver bars toward a spear.
Nala told Dray she will hunt the greymaws alone, and put up to two silver bars toward a spear.

event: Dray brings her a canvas knapsack, the dead watchman's; the chambers go in, the white-eye's on top.

make.title: Canvas Knapsack
make.description: A worn canvas knapsack with a flap and two leather shoulder straps.

changes.note: Dray gives her the dead watchman's knapsack

memory.fact: Dray's spare pack is a canvas knapsack with leather straps, left by the watchman the greymaws took.
Dray's spare pack is a canvas knapsack with leather straps, left by the watchman the greymaws took.
Nala carries the four greymaw chambers in the dead watchman's knapsack, the white-eye's on top.
Nala carries the four greymaw chambers in the dead watchman's knapsack, the white-eye's on top.

event: A bar for the hunt, to the spear; only Hob Tarrant forges better: cold iron, three days, a bar.

memory.fact: For the hunt Dray pays a silver bar beyond the head bounty, and will put it toward a spear.
For the hunt Dray pays a silver bar beyond the head bounty, and will put it toward a spear.
Besides Hob's forge, no spear better than the watch's plain iron is to be had short of Carrowmouth.
Besides Hob's forge, no spear better than the watch's plain iron is to be had short of Carrowmouth.
Hob Tarrant can forge a boar spear with a cold-iron head in three days, for a silver bar.
Hob Tarrant can forge a boar spear with a cold-iron head in three days, for a silver bar.

event: Dray's forearms go grey as stone and grate like millstones: she hunts alone once she bests him.

memory.fact: Dray's Talent turns his forearms grey and hard as stone; they grate like millstones.
Dray's Talent turns his forearms grey and hard as stone; they grate like millstones.
Dray lets no one hunt alone for him till they best him in a bout: her spear against his Stonehand.
Dray lets no one hunt alone for him till they best him in a bout: her spear against his Stonehand.
Dray challenged Nala to the bout at once, on the green: a watch spear against his hands.
Dray challenged Nala to the bout at once, on the green: a watch spear against his hands.

event: Nala warns she'd hate to hurt him; he laughs: "I'm at First Depth, lass. I'd like to see you try."

memory.fact: Nala told Dray the stragglers are no threat to her alone, and she would hate to hurt him needlessly.
Nala told Dray the stragglers are no threat to her alone, and she would hate to hurt him needlessly.
Dray, at First Depth, doubts a Surface stranger could hurt him, and says so with a grim smile.
Dray, at First Depth, doubts a Surface stranger could hurt him, and says so with a grim smile.

event: Killing the white-eye proves she can kill, not how she fights a man; he'll see her fight first.

memory.fact: Dray holds to his test: killing the white-eye proves she can kill, not how she fights a man.
Dray holds to his test: killing the white-eye proves she can kill, not how she fights a man.

event: Folk line the green; Anselm watches white-faced at the gate, and Col grins in the doorway.

memory.fact: Folk gather on the green to watch the Reeve's bout, and Anselm watches white-faced.
Folk gather on the green to watch the Reeve's bout, and Anselm watches white-faced.

event: Dray plants a plain iron spear in the turf: take it up, or hunt with the watch.

memory.fact: Dray planted a plain iron spear on the green for Nala: fight him with it, or hunt with the watch.
Dray planted a plain iron spear on the green for Nala: fight him with it, or hunt with the watch.

event: At ten paces she lunges, pulling Dray in and pushing the spear ahead of her arm.

memory.fact: Undertow can drive a plain iron spear faster than her arm alone; only cold iron it cannot move.
Undertow can drive a plain iron spear faster than her arm alone; only cold iron it cannot move.
Pulled by Undertow, Dray feels a tide drag at him, and knows at once her Talent is no small one.
Pulled by Undertow, Dray feels a tide drag at him, and knows at once her Talent is no small one.

event: He rides the pull, turns his shoulder, and the point shrieks off his stone forearm.

changes.note: The surge of pull and push on Dray spends her Water

memory.fact: Dray rode Undertow's pull instead of fighting it, and it carried him inside Nala's spear.
Dray rode Undertow's pull instead of fighting it, and it carried him inside Nala's spear.
Dray fights close, catching points on his stone forearms and hitting like a falling wall.
Dray fights close, catching points on his stone forearms and hitting like a falling wall.

event: His stone fist slams her ribs; she lands flat on her back in the wet grass, the spear spinning away.

changes.note: Dray's stone fist bruises her ribs

memory.fact: Dray's stone fist threw Nala flat in the first bout; her ribs are bruised but whole.
Dray's stone fist threw Nala flat in the first bout; her ribs are bruised but whole.

event: "That pull. I felt the whole river take hold of me." The stone fades from his hand to flesh.

memory.fact: When Dray lets his Talent go, the grey stone fades from his hands back to flesh.
When Dray lets his Talent go, the grey stone fades from his hands back to flesh.

event: "You're no small Talent, lass. But you fight like one. Again?" She takes his hand and rises.

memory.fact: Dray judges Nala no small Talent, but says she fights like one, and offers another bout.
Dray judges Nala no small Talent, but says she fights like one, and offers another bout.

event: This time she circles, feinting at knee and face; Dray braces against a pull that never comes.

memory.fact: Wary now of her pull, Dray braces against it, and a sudden push then overbalances him.
Wary now of her pull, Dray braces against it, and a sudden push then overbalances him.

event: He swings his whole weight; she slips back, and pushes instead: he staggers, flank open.

memory.fact: Dray leans his weight into every swing; at the end of one his flank is open for a heartbeat.
Dray leans his weight into every swing; at the end of one his flank is open for a heartbeat.

event: She steps in and touches the point to his side above his belt. "Struck true. That'll do."

changes.note: Her well refills as the second bout ends

memory.fact: For Dray a spear point touched to his body anywhere below the stone counts as struck true.
For Dray a spear point touched to his body anywhere below the stone counts as struck true.
Nala struck Dray true in the second bout, and he lets her hunt the greymaws alone.
Nala struck Dray true in the second bout, and he lets her hunt the greymaws alone.
Dray yields the moment he is struck true or thrown down; he does not fight on from pride.

event: The green roars; Col bangs his stick, and Anselm sags laughing against the gatepost.
"Hunt alone, then. The cart's back by noon, and I'll pay you then. See Hob about that spear."

memory.fact: Dray will pay Nala when his cart is back by noon, and sent her to see Hob about a spear.
Dray will pay Nala when his cart is back by noon, and sent her to see Hob about a spear.
